theorems.name: Submission.bv_translate_sub_lintegral_le_of_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Rn n → ℝ) (w : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (Q : Set (Rn n)) (z : Rn n) (C : ℝ≥0∞), AEStronglyMeasurable F volume → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (w j) volume) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫⁻ x, ‖w j x - F x‖ₑ) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ j, ∫⁻ x in Q, ‖w j (x - z) - w j x‖ₑ ≤ C) → ∫⁻ x in Q, ‖F (x - z) - F x‖ₑ ≤ C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
